title: PDU-Transport: Allow different ID and Length size
description:
Allowing configurable size of ID and Length field based on the port
number can be configured via a new UAT.

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • a456f32e - PDU-Transport: Allow different ID and Length size
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/19047/diffs?diff_id=1266885313&start_sha=ea28cdc0f18253426576394ddae02eb1f12b3fab)
I suggest using 0 as a wildcard, since it's a reserved port anyways.

RFC6335 does not really say that port 0 will be reserved forever. Instead it states `which may be used to extend these ranges or the overall port number space in the future`.

So the better solution is to use a port outside the range, that is why I used `65536` as there is not a significant downside to that.
